title: Set 16

sentences.ko: 택배가 일요일부터 물류센터에 묶여서 안 움직여. 화요일에 온다더니 아무도 아무 말을 안 해 줘.
sentences.text: My package has been stuck at a sorting center since Sunday. It was supposed to be here Tuesday and nobody can tell me anything.

alts.text: Same sorting center since Sunday, hasn't moved once. They said Tuesday and now nobody knows anything.
My parcel has remained at a sorting facility since Sunday. It was scheduled to arrive on Tuesday, and no one has been able to give me an explanation.

sentences.note: **stuck at** 은 한자리에서 꼼짝 안 하는 상태예요. 배송 추적에 나오는 물류센터는 **sorting center** 라고 합니다.

sentences.ko: 지난봄에 주인이 바뀌고 나서 국수 맛이 예전 같지가 않아. 그래도 계속 가게 되더라.
sentences.text: The place changed owners last spring and the noodles aren't the same. I keep going anyway.

alts.text: Different owner since spring and the noodles are just okay now. Still go there anyway.
The restaurant changed hands last spring, and the noodles have not been the same since. I continue to go regardless.

sentences.note: 가게 주인이 바뀐 건 **changed owners**, 격식 있게는 **changed hands** 라고 해요. 맛이 예전만 못하다는 말은 **aren't the same** 이면 충분합니다.

sentences.ko: 엘리베이터가 또 고장 났다고 둘러댔어. 사실은 알람 소리도 못 듣고 자다가 10시 10분에 들어갔어.
sentences.text: I told them the elevator was broken again. Really, I slept through my alarm and walked in at ten past ten.

alts.text: Blamed the elevator again. Truth is I slept right through my alarm and got in at ten past ten.
I informed them that the elevator was out of order again. In fact, I slept through my alarm and did not arrive until ten past ten.

sentences.note: 알람을 못 듣고 계속 잔 건 **slept through my alarm** 입니다. 시각은 **ten past ten** 처럼 말해요.

sentences.ko: 그 아파트 결국 샀어? 내가 마지막으로 들었을 땐 아직 대출 기다리고 있었잖아.
sentences.text: Did you ever end up buying that apartment? Last I knew you were still waiting on the loan.

alts.text: So did you get that apartment or what? Thought you were still stuck waiting on the bank.
Did you end up purchasing that apartment? The last I heard, you were still waiting for the loan to come through.

sentences.note: **Last I knew** 는 내가 마지막으로 알기로는 그랬다는 뜻이에요. 대출을 기다린다고 할 때는 **waiting on the loan** 처럼 on 을 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 일요일이 올해 제일 더운 날이라고 해서 등산을 아침 여섯 시로 옮겼어. 언니는 벌써 안 가겠다고 했고.
sentences.text: Sunday's going to be the hottest day of the year, so we moved the hike to six in the morning. My sister already backed out.

alts.text: It's supposed to be crazy hot Sunday, so we bumped the hike to six a.m. My sister's not coming.
Sunday is expected to be the hottest day of the year, so we moved the hike to six in the morning. My sister has already decided not to join us.

sentences.note: 약속 시간을 옮길 때는 **moved the hike to six** 처럼 move 를 씁니다. 하기로 한 걸 무르는 건 **backed out** 이에요.

reviewed: 1번 casual 이 물류센터를 warehouse 라고 해서 text 와 note 가 가르치는 sorting center 와 어긋났습니다. 같은 말로 맞췄습니다.
2번 casual 의 every week 는 text 에 없는 내용을 더한 것이라 뺐습니다. 말투만 바꾸고 내용은 그대로 두었습니다.
4번 note 의 한국어 설명이 문장으로 끝나지 않아 읽기 어색해서 다듬었습니다.
